description: Renders one quantstats HTML report per symbol from a long table of periodic returns
comment: Groups by symbol internally, so the SQL needs no GROUP BY; a benchmark is just another symbol of the same table, serves as input only and gets no report of its own
example: SELECT unnest(qs_html_reports(symbol, trade_date, daily_return, NULL)) FROM daily_returns; SELECT unnest(qs_html_reports(symbol, trade_date, daily_return, {'benchmark': ['SPX'], 'title': symbol, 'output_dir': 'reports/'}::qs_html_report_options)) FROM daily_returns

description: Renders one quantstats HTML report per symbol from a long table of prices or NAVs, differencing them into returns first
comment: The value column is a level, not a change: every symbol, the benchmark included, is converted with price_t / price_{t-1} - 1 before rendering
example: SELECT unnest(qs_html_reports_by_prices(symbol, date, price, NULL)) FROM prices; SELECT unnest(qs_html_reports_by_prices(symbol, date, price, {'benchmark': ['SPX'], 'title': symbol, 'output_dir': 'reports/'}::qs_html_report_options)) FROM prices
